verdict.rationale: Fivetran is a SaaS data-movement platform that handles customer data and ships AI features such as an AI support assistant, so a buyer could fairly ask about its AI-training data policy; the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting, or contractual commitment preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. Data blocking and column hashing only control what syncs to the customer's own destination, so they are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
